name: Buon Choah rice
summary: Rice from Buôn Choáh in Krong No, the province’s largest rice bowl, on volcanic soil. The tourism portal says it is fragrant, sticky, and deeply sweet, and grown to VietGAP. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022. The handbook spells the commune Buôn Choáh. The portal title spells Buôn Choah.
taste: The tourism portal says the rice is fragrant, sticky, and deeply sweet.
howToEat: The tourism portal credits volcanic soil, the climate, and mineral-rich irrigation water, plus VietGAP growing. It does not print a cook ratio. Cook it as rice. A bag price is Check on arrival.
where: Xã Buôn Choáh, or Buôn Choah on the tourism portal, Krong No. A shop was not named. Hours are Check on arrival.
